scripts.db:migrate: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-ChildItem 'infra/migrations/*.sql' | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object { Write-Host \"Applying $($_.Name)\"; Get-Content $_.FullName | docker exec -i compliancecore-postgres psql -U compliancecore -d compliancecore -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 }"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
